Direction screen: the located quantitative literature treats limitation of motion as the measured OUTCOME of upstream disease rather than as a source of downstream conditions - the Klim 2023 randomized trial of thumb carpometacarpal arthroplasty measures range of motion as a surgical outcome of osteoarthritis (PMID 37140370), the Schultheis 2024 dorsal-root-ganglion-stimulation cohort measures knee range of motion as a functional outcome of chronic postsurgical pain (PMID 36464561), and the Patel 2020 adhesive-capsulitis review has fibrosis and contracture producing stiffness and restriction of motion (PMID 33633420) - so an outgoing edge from this identity would invert the documented direction of every located pair.

Constitutive and container screens: the only located material running from motion loss toward a secondary is the Zhou 2020 rabbit immobilization model, in which cast immobilization produced progressive motion restriction with capsular collagen deposition and TGF-beta1 elevation advancing to contracture (PMID 30562834) - an animal immobilization-exposure model in which limitation of motion and contracture are successive descriptions of one capsular fibrosis process (constitutive guard against a limitation-of-motion-to-contractures edge, matching the batch-24 contractures deferral and the loss-of-use-of-extremities rating-framework-container screen of batch 44) - and the generic disuse-atrophy literature (McKendry 2024, PMID 39106083; Howard 2020, PMID 32167129) is scoped to unloading, immobilization, bed rest, and hospitalization exposures rather than to graded limitation of motion as the causal exposure. Reopening condition: a condition-specific cohort in which documented, graded limitation of motion (goniometric range-of-motion loss) precedes and quantifies a catalog-fit secondary such as disuse muscle atrophy with the exposure defined by the motion loss rather than by immobilization or disease activity, or a qualified-human governance decision that treats this impairment-container identity as a mappable source with an approved target list.
governanceNotes: D1 batch 54 (2026-09-25): deferred. Outcome-not-diagnosis and rating-framework-container screens recorded 2026-09-25: the identity is named 'Limitation of motion' and sits in the musculoskeletal expansion wave as an impairment measurement - the same container class the program has already screened against authoring at the loss-of-use-of-extremities and joint-replacement-residuals steps (batches 44-45) and at the batch-24 contractures deferral, where phenotype heterogeneity across joints and etiologies prevented any single defensible edge. Every located human cohort runs upstream: range of motion is the dependent variable in osteoarthritis surgery trials and in postsurgical-pain neuromodulation cohorts, and the direction of the adhesive-capsulitis and arthrofibrosis literature is fibrosis-to-stiffness. The rabbit immobilization model (PMID 30562834) documents that motion restriction progresses to capsular contracture under immobilization, but limitation of motion and contracture are two stages of one fibrotic process rather than a primary-secondary pair, and the disuse-atrophy evidence base is exposure-scoped to immobilization and unloading. No edges authored; the identity is retained as a draft with suggestions: [] pending a qualified-human governance decision or a condition-specific cohort meeting the recorded reopening condition.
